scenario.name: Test: drupal_850
scenario.author: Thomas Shaw
scenario.description: Single-VM test scenario for the drupal_850 vulnerability module on patched PHP 7.4 (Debian 10 Buster), used to exercise its secgen_test via the Proxmox QEMU Guest Agent testing pipeline. No attacker VM: the msf tier-3 exploit is exercised in a separate scenario.
